Hi Sofia,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear that order SO-62115 arrived late and with a damaged carton.

Could you reply with a photo of the crushed carton and let us know whether any of its contents were affected? Once we have that, we'll review the order and follow up with options, which may include a replacement or refund for the damaged items.

We'll also look into what caused the delay so we can prevent it going forward.

Apologies again for the inconvenience — we'll get this sorted out for you.

Best regards,
Northwind Analytics Support
